label: Mistral AI
agentGuide: Base path /v1, OpenAI-shaped. Chat: POST /chat/completions {"model": "mistral-small-latest", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]} (choices[0].message.content; "response_format": {"type": "json_object"} for JSON). Models: GET /models. Embeddings: POST /embeddings {"model": "mistral-embed", "input": ["..."]}. OCR of a document by URL: POST /ocr {"model": "mistral-ocr-latest", "document": {"type": "document_url", "document_url": "https://..."}} (pages[].markdown). Agents and conversations: POST /conversations. Every call is billed to the key. The key is set by Allkin.
